attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

mcd16-1.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

mcd16-2.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

mcd16-3.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Epic Splash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

mcd16-4.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

mcd16-5.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

mcd16-6.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

mcd16-7.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

attacks.name: Heartfelt Song
attacks.text: Discard a Darkness Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

mcd16-8.flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

mcd16-9.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd16-10.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

attacks.name: Act Tough
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage.

mcd16-11.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

mcd16-12.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
